summary:
Doomspacecraft is an interactive, browser-based 3D aerospace engineering simulation and mission-design game where 1–4 players design, configure, launch, and fly real-world space missions. Players step into the shoes of mission architects—balancing coupled engineering constraints including mass margins, power generation, battery depth of discharge, telemetry buffers, radiation shielding, and thermal lifetime across four realistic destination scenarios (Earth SSO, Lunar South Pole, Mars Reconnaissance, and Europa Flyby).

The game directly addresses the challenge of making complex aerospace engineering accessible and captivating to students, engineers, and space enthusiasts alike. Powered by live NASA space-weather data (DONKI API) and authentic mission parameters, Doomspacecraft bridges the gap between high-level celestial science and real flight operations without any login barriers, installations, or external dependencies.
details:
Doomspacecraft transforms complex spacecraft sizing mathematics into an engaging, tactile 3D experience. Players choose a mission destination, assemble their satellite bus, mount realistic science instruments (such as synthetic aperture radars, multispectral imagers, and magnetometers), select propulsion and launch vehicles, and balance coupled subsystems in real time.

Once flight certification is approved, players execute a terminal countdown and liftoff sequence, entering an orbital simulation phase. During flight, players navigate daylight/eclipse cycles, ground-station downlink windows, space-weather storms, and interactive in-flight anomaly cards where every decision permanently alters spacecraft integrity, propellant reserves, and mission science return.

Doomspacecraft operates entirely client-side using native ES modules and WebGL/Three.js:

1. Physics & Constraint Sizing Engine: Every component selection triggers a coupled multi-variable aerospace analysis calculating orbit-specific payload mass, solar array output factoring in solar flux and orbital eclipse fractions, battery endurance during umbra passes, communications data rates versus Deep Space Network (DSN) windows, and radiation dose versus avionics shielding.

2. 3D Procedural Visualization: Features procedurally generated celestial bodies (Earth, Moon, Mars, Europa) with multi-layer Rayleigh atmospheric limb scattering, orbital inclination rings, umbra eclipse arcs, and a dynamic spacecraft builder that reconstructs the 3D model in real time based on active subsystem choices.

3. Live NASA DONKI Integration: Actively queries real-time Coronal Mass Ejections (CME) and Solar Flare (FLR) events to subject the orbital vehicle to authentic solar weather and particle flux.

4. Collaborative Crew Mode: Supports 4 distributed crew seats (Mission Director, Systems Engineer, Principal Investigator, and Flight Dynamics Officer) syncing state in real time across browser tabs via BroadcastChannel.

- Educational & Authentic: Replaces arbitrary game mechanics with authentic NASA mission constraints and real aerospace trade-offs.

- Zero-Friction Accessibility: Runs client-side in any modern browser on desktop or mobile, installs offline as a Progressive Web App (PWA), and requires zero logins, accounts, or software installs.

- Causal Mission Debriefs: Features a post-flight review system grading missions across 6 categories (Science Return, Engineering Margins, Cost Efficiency, Orbit Feasibility, Anomaly Management, and Flight Operations) with causal diagnostics explaining precisely why designs succeeded or failed.

Our goal is to demystify aerospace engineering and orbital mechanics for future engineers, students, and citizens globally. By showing how science goals, budgets, and physical laws intersect in mission architecture, Doomspacecraft inspires the next generation of space explorers to design missions that explore our universe safely and effectively.

- Languages: JavaScript (ES Modules), HTML5, CSS3.

- 3D Graphics: Three.js (r160, vendored locally for zero-CDN offline reliability) and WebGL.

- Audio: Web Audio API (procedural frequency synthesis and noise buffers with zero audio files).

- APIs & Data: NASA Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (DONKI) REST API.

- Hosting & Deployment: Firebase Hosting edge CDN with automated SPA rewrites and SSL.

- Development & QA Tools: Node.js, Vite, Git, and automated constraint feasibility analyzers.
